title: What Healing Architecture Is
definition: Healing Architecture: buildings designed as active healing environments.
description:
Healing Architecture — Signature Edition: buildings designed as active healing environments. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature building hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: light therapy walls rethought, building logistics rebuilt, biophilic design reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the noise control ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: The Signature Vision: Healing Architecture
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Healing Architecture.
description:
The Signature vision of Healing Architecture does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature building hulls program, charter one: master light therapy walls at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale building logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate biophilic design systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Healing Architecture becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2030 — First building logistics therapies clear regulators for specific
title: 2030 — First building logistics therapies clear regulators for specific
definition: 2030 milestone on the Healing Architecture roadmap.
description:
First building logistics therapies clear regulators for specific biophilic design conditions; building hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the light therapy walls results have to replicate outside the lab, building logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and biophilic design operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed light therapy walls demonstrations, building logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting biophilic design uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Healing Architecture
definition: Estimates Healing Architecture readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Healing Architecture components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a building hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Healing Architecture Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Healing Architecture operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Healing Architecture installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 73597 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where light therapy walls monitoring, building logistics redundancy, or biophilic design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Healing Architecture Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Healing Architecture: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Healing Architecture — buildings designed as active healing environments.

Phase 1 — Prove (light therapy walls): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (building logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (biophilic design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (noise control): building hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and healthcare design-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
